intro.title: Quick 5-question survey
intro.description: Answer 5 short A/B questions. Your answers lead to a tailored set of follow-up prompts at the end.
intro.outcomeIntro: Below are 3 real prompts, each answered two different ways. For each one, read both responses and pick the one that feels more like how you'd actually want AI to talk to you - not which one is "better written," but which one fits you. There's no right answer. Go with your gut.
